in_sanskrit.name: काव्यश्री
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is adorned with poems, or the one who is the personification of poetry. Kavya means poetry, and shrī means adorned or prosperous.

in_hindi.name: काव्यश्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: She is ancient, or filled with poetry, or composed of ancient poems.

in_tamil.name: காவ்யஸ்ரீ
in_tamil.long_meaning: She is one who holds poetry, or she is adorned with poetry.

in_telugu.name: కావ్యశ్రీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: She is the goddess of poetry, or the one who is filled with poetry.

in_marathi.name: Kavyasree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Poetess, Goddess of poetry
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavyasree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kavya meaning poet, Sree meaning goddess. Kavyasree is a name given to the goddess of poetry or a poetess.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Poetess, Goddess of poetry
